headword: {永久欠番|えいきゅうけつばん}

definitions.gloss: retired number; permanently retired uniform number
definitions.explanation: A uniform number that a sports team withdraws from use in honor of a great player, so that no one wears it again. Most familiar from professional baseball, but also used for football and other team sports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{背番号|せばんごう}→背番号：33903_sebangou⟧3⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{永久欠番|えいきゅうけつばん}だ。
⟦{球団|きゅうだん}→球団：16190_kyuudan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{永久欠番|えいきゅうけつばん}にした。

{引退式|いんたいしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧たたえて⟦{背番号|せばんごう}→背番号：33903_sebangou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{永久欠番|えいきゅうけつばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At the retirement ceremony it was announced that, in honor of the player's long career, the number would be retired.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{永久|えいきゅう}→永久：01875_eikyuu⟧ (permanent) + {欠番|けつばん} (a number left unused). Used figuratively, too, for something so closely tied to one person that no one else could fill the role.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {永久欠番|えいきゅうけつばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to retire (a number)
- {永久欠番|えいきゅうけつばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: (of a number) to be retired
- {永久欠番|えいきゅうけつばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be designated a retired number

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{背番号|せばんごう}→背番号：33903_sebangou⟧: uniform number
- {欠番|けつばん}: a missing or unused number in a series
